questions.text: Please introduce yourself briefly and tell me what drew you to web development.
Can you explain the difference between HTML, CSS, and JavaScript?
What is the DOM, and why does it matter for front-end work?
How would you center a div both horizontally and vertically using CSS?
What is the difference between let, const, and var in JavaScript?
A button on a page does nothing when clicked. How would you start debugging that?
How would you make a simple webpage look acceptable on both desktop and mobile?
Describe how you would approach building a simple to-do list app in the browser.
Tell me about a time you got stuck on a coding problem. How did you resolve it?
How would you explain a technical concept like an API to a non-technical teammate?
What tools or resources do you use when learning a new web technology?
Can you explain what a promise is in JavaScript and when you might use async/await?
